description: Somos uma equipe de alunos do 9º ano, unidos pela determinação, confiança e vontade de vencer. Acreditamos no nosso potencial e sabemos que cada desafio é uma oportunidade de mostrar que somos capazes de ir além. Juntos, buscamos superar nossos limites, aprender com cada experiência e provar que, com união, esforço e dedicação, podemos alcançar grandes conquistas. Não estamos aqui apenas para participar, mas para fazer história e mostrar a nossa força!
summary: The project consists of a game that integrates entertainment and knowledge by explaining the history of abandoned equipment in a way that is engaging for school-aged audiences. The importance of the project lies in the democratization of information and the potential to inspire young people to enter this field and possibly, in the future, become part of its professional team.
details: The project is a clicker-style game built using SI and HTML, designed to simultaneously provide knowledge and entertainment, with the goal of appealing to a school-aged audience—as requested in the challenge. Another notable feature is the game's mechanic: gears serve as the in-game currency and can be earned through clicks, by acquiring abandoned robots that generate them automatically, or as a reward for reading stories. With its high level of accessibility, the project offers an innovative way to learn about space.
